environment: SITL: ArduCopter 4.7.1 (dbe79216, binary sha256 fdc6f68f...) in an isolated network namespace, pipe transport, wall-clock 1x
not_claimed: estimator compromise (the simulator never receives a modified frame)
physical flight deviation (the simulated vehicle flies its commanded path regardless)
GPS spoofing of the vehicle, real RF, or any behaviour of a real vehicle or the physical Pixhawk
detection by the ML detector (it is OFF for every ArduPilot result; the Stage-1 model does not transfer)
a detection RATE (n=3 flights, one scenario, one airframe/world/host)

attack.mechanism: In-path rewrite of downlink GLOBAL_POSITION_INT lat/lon (msgid 33, sysid 1/compid 1) with a closed-form eastward drift of 5 m/s starting 5 s after the attacker first sees relative_alt >= 12 m on that same downlink, lasting 25 s (125 m total); vx/vy/vz/alt/relative_alt/hdg stay truthful; MAVLink 2 CRC recomputed; every other frame byte-identical.
attack.implementation: aegisflight.proxy.attacks_live.PositionDriftAttack (reviewed, unchanged) wrapped by scripts/ardupilot/ap_attack.py (adds only the attacker-observable airborne gate)
attack.injection_point: downlink, simulator -> IDS (Windows side of the pipe)
attack.attacker_knowledge: only frames on the downlink; no simulator ground truth, no detector state

expected_observable_effect.on_the_wire: GLOBAL_POSITION_INT lat/lon diverge eastward from the truthful GPS_RAW_INT lat/lon and from the position implied by the (truthful) reported velocity, growing about 5 m per second to about 125 m
expected_observable_effect.frames_modified_expected: about 25 s x ~4.6 Hz = ~114; evaluation requires >= 80
expected_observable_effect.hypothesis: the physics-consistency detector's position-residual check (soft 12 m, hard 30 m in configs/detector.yaml) trips and fusion raises a GPS_SPOOFING alert within roughly 15 s of onset (descriptive; the pass/fail criteria below use the whole window)

config_note: Stage-1 configs/ unchanged; ML detector disabled via --no-ml because the benign ArduPilot flights show it is the sole in-flight false-alarm source (see clean_baseline). No threshold was tuned and no ArduPilot profile exists.

clean_baseline.reading: ML-off in-flight alerts are 0 over the benign flights; the only ML-off alerts are 5 per flight in the boot/await_gps start-up (no GPS lock, sentinel values), outside the scored window.

definitions.D1: at least one alert decision (is_alert) in [onset, window_end + post_window_grace_s] in the OBSERVED arm
definitions.D2: the FIRST such alert has type GPS_SPOOFING
definitions.D3: the first such alert lists physics_consistency among its contributing detectors
definitions.C1: the CONTROL arm (same flight's clean frames replayed under the same config/model) has zero alert decisions in the same window
definitions.B1: zero alert decisions in the observed arm's in-flight phases (takeoff/square/rtl/landed) before onset
definitions.verdict: DETECTED iff D1, D2, D3, C1 and B1 all hold; MISSED if the run is valid and any fails; INVALID if a validity gate fails (reported, then replaced by a fresh run of the same spec)

trial_plan.command: scripts/ardupilot/run_ap_sitl_ids.py --name <run> --stream six --profile flight --no-ml --attack "position_drift:onset=5,duration=25,rate=5,bearing=90,airborne_m=12"  then  scripts/ardupilot/evaluate_ap_attack.py artifacts/ardupilot/<run> --prereg artifacts/ardupilot/p2_position_drift_preregistration.json --json artifacts/ardupilot/<run>/evaluation.json
rules: all three runs are reported, hits and misses alike
no parameter, threshold or criterion changes after the first run
a run that fails a validity gate is reported INVALID and replaced once by a fresh run of the same spec
